errors.description: Spread measured at the centre-front vertex where the two leaves cross - the same vertex the drawing's leader lines radiate from. Candidate: apex (443,545), left tip (255,795), right tip (612,795), half-angles 36.9 and 34.1, total 71.0 degrees. Blueprint: apex (107.5,98), tips (86.5,128) and (125,128), total 65.4 degrees geometric with 60.00 PRINTED on the drawing.
errors.expected: 60 degrees printed, about 65 as actually drawn between the two leaf front edges
errors.actual: 71 degrees - roughly 6 wider than the drawn geometry and 11 wider than the printed figure
errors.correction: Set each leaf front edge 30 degrees off vertical from the centre-front vertex so the two edges enclose a tight 60 degree wedge; with a 250px vertical drop from the vertex each tip lands about 145px out from centre, leaving a narrow keyhole opening with the leaves close-cut against the throat.

errors.description: Horizontal half-widths from apex to tip: left 188px, right 169px, a 10.6 percent difference. Tip heights match at y=795.
errors.actual: Left leaf splays about 19px wider than the right at the tip
errors.correction: Mirror the left and right leaf front edges exactly about the placket centreline so both tips sit at equal horizontal offset and equal height.

errors.description: Point length from the centre-front vertex to the tip, normalised by centre-front collar height. Candidate 313/368 = 0.85; blueprint 36.6/45 = 0.81.
errors.correction: Shorten each leaf by roughly 15px along its axis so the tip sits at 0.81 of the vertex-to-top-edge distance, keeping the short neat fashion-point proportion.

lockedFeatures: DEAD-ON FRONTAL CAMERA with both leaves equally presented and fully readable - the oblique collapse that made three collars interchangeable is gone
Acute straight-sided point termination, correct for a fashion point
At 71 degrees this is unmistakably narrower than the 84 / 89 / 81 degree siblings, so it is no longer interchangeable with them
No necktie; collar band, spread and throat button all unobstructed
Top button fastened with the placket button visible inside the V, matching the drawing
Clean seamless mid-grey ground, soft directional light, visible poplin weave and edge topstitching
notes:
The named defect is genuinely fixed.

ROOT-CAUSE FINDING: spec.json records measured.angles as EMPTY even though the illustration prints 60.00 degrees as text on the drawing. The extraction never reads printed callouts, so the number never reaches the prompt - which is why the spread drifts wide.

Residual cross-option risk: collar-sq-65-btn also renders at about 70 degrees, so those two now share a spread and are separated only by sq-65-btn's tip buttons.

NOT measurable: real-world centimetres from the drawing - scaling by the neck button (about 6px) gives about 6.6 cm for a leaf labelled 5.8 cm, so the linework is not dimensionally exact and length was judged only as a ratio.
